lines.text: God tells Ezekiel to declare that the Day of the LORD is near, and a sword will come against Egypt.
On that day messengers will go out from God in ships to frighten Cush out of complacency.
God will put an end to the hordes of Egypt by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Assyria.
God will destroy the idols in Memphis, set fire to Zoan, and darken the day in Damascus.
God has broken the arm of Pharaoh and will place His sword in the hand of Babylon's king.
